expectedBehavior: Pattern /[​-‍﻿]/ (zero-width space, joiner, non-joiner) weight=10 → hard blocks any token with these chars
failureMode: Some legitimate tokens may use zero-width chars in name for branding; blocked incorrectly
prerequisites: Token with zero-width characters in name

description: 4+ non-ASCII character pattern flags suspicious international scam names
expectedBehavior: Pattern /[^\x00-\x7F]{4,}/ weight=5: token name with 4+ non-ASCII chars gets flagged
failureMode: Legitimate international token with Japanese/Korean name gets flagged as suspicious
prerequisites: Token with 4+ Unicode characters in symbol

description: All 25+ knowledge bases applied sequentially in filterPreyAdvanced
expectedBehavior: Steps 1-5: scam patterns, online research, pre-screen batch, RugCheck, age anomaly — each layer filters or flags
failureMode: If any step throws unexpectedly, the token processing for that iteration may break (no catch around entire per-token loop)
prerequisites: Any token passing through trash layer

description: 7 scoring dimensions with correct max points per dimension
expectedBehavior: liquidity(25) + supply(20) + age(15) + priceAction(20) + nameHygiene(10) + feeIntegrity(15) + distribution(15) = 120 theoretical max, clamped to 100
failureMode: Maximum raw score = 120 but finalScore clamped to 100 — market multiplier at 1.0 means scores >100 are possible before clamping
prerequisites: Token scoring across all dimensions

description: Market-condition multipliers adjust thresholds per regime
expectedBehavior: EXTREME: 1.30, HOT: 0.85, NORMAL: 1.00, COLD: 1.15, DEAD: 1.40 — higher multiplier means more restrictive
failureMode: DEAD multiplier 1.40 means a raw score of 71 becomes 100 (BLOCKED) — tokens that would be WARN in NORMAL get BLOCKED in DEAD
prerequisites: Token with raw score ~71 in DEAD market

description: Tier boundaries: ALLOW(0-25), FLAG(26-50), WARN(51-75), BLOCK(76-100)
expectedBehavior: tierFor: <=25 ALLOW, <=50 FLAG, <=75 WARN, >75 BLOCK
failureMode: Score exactly 25: ALLOW (<=25). Score 25.5: FLAG (>25). Integer scoring avoids fractional edge cases
prerequisites: Token scoring exactly at tier boundary

description: Hard-block gates: missing mint, dust liquidity, zero swaps, dust MCAP
expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: !token.mint → block; liq < $500 → block; swaps < 1 → block; mcap > 0 && mcap < $1000 → block
failureMode: MCAP check is `mcap > 0 && mcap < MIN_MCAP_USD` — if mcap is 0 (unknown), token passes because first condition fails
prerequisites: Token with mcap=0 (not yet tracked)

description: Supply data missing or zero forces block with reason
expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: supply <= 0 or not finite → 'supply_invalid' block
failureMode: Token with extremely large supply (1e12) passes, but potentially a dilution risk
prerequisites: Token with supply = 0 or null

description: Token age < 30 seconds hard-blocked as 'too_young'
expectedBehavior: computeAgeSeconds < 30 → hard block with reason including seconds old
failureMode: Token with no created_at passes this gate entirely (ageSec===null, checked only if ageSec !== null)
prerequisites: Token under 30 seconds old with creation timestamp

description: 5m price change > 1500% triggers hard block as 'already gone'
expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: Math.abs(p5m) > MAX_PRICE_CHANGE_5M_PCT (1500) → block
failureMode: Token pumped 1501% in 5m blocked; 1499% passes to dimension scoring (but gets 20pts in priceAction for >1500 anyway)
prerequisites: Token with extreme 5m price movement

description: Blacklisted tokens from rug memory are hard-blocked
expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: rugMemory.blacklisted_tokens.includes(token.mint) → 'blacklisted_token'
failureMode: rugMemory is optional — if null/undefined, blacklist check is skipped entirely
prerequisites: Token previously recorded as rug in rug-memory.json

description: Blacklisted devs from rug memory block all new tokens from same creator
expectedBehavior: checkHardBlocks: rugMemory.blacklisted_devs.includes(token.creator) → 'blacklisted_dev'
failureMode: Creator address stored with different case or format in token vs rug memory — string match fails
prerequisites: Creator previously rugged another token, new token from same creator

description: LP/MCAP ratio < 2% flagged as rug-prone (score +8)
expectedBehavior: scoreLiquidity: lpRatio < 0.02 → +8 pts and 'rug-prone' reason
failureMode: LP/MCAP ratio 0.0199 gives +8; ratio 0.0200 passes to next tier (+4) — thin margin for significant scoring diff
prerequisites: Token with liquidity much lower than market cap

description: LP/MCAP ratio > 80% flagged as over-collateralized honeypot
expectedBehavior: scoreLiquidity: lpRatio > 0.80 → +3 pts and 'over-collateralized, possible honeypot' reason
failureMode: Legitimate token with LP=MCAP (no price discovery yet) incorrectly flagged as honeypot
prerequisites: Token where 100% of market cap is in LP (very new token)

description: Supply scoring: near-zero token price triggers dilution risk penalty
expectedBehavior: scoreSupply: mcap/supply < 1e-9 → +6 pts 'massive supply dilution'; < 1e-7 → +3 pts 'very low token price'
failureMode: Token with mcap=0 (unknown): pricePerToken = 0/supply = 0; 0 < 1e-9 true → adds dilution points even without data
prerequisites: Token with unknown market cap but known supply

description: Whale-sized avg buy triggers supply concentration +5
expectedBehavior: scoreSupply: avgBuySize > $10k → +5 pts 'whale-sized avg buy'; > $5k → +3pts 'large avg buy'
failureMode: Single legitimate whale buying during distribution phase triggers concentration penalty
prerequisites: Token with one large buyer making multiple purchases

description: Extreme buy imbalance (>90% buys) detected as self-buying +6
expectedBehavior: scoreSupply: h1Buys/h1Total > 0.90 → +6 pts 'likely self-buying'
failureMode: Legitimate token in organic accumulation phase (strong buying pressure) incorrectly penalized
prerequisites: Token with h1 buys > 90% of total transactions

description: Age scoring: brand new token (<30s) gets max 15 pts 'insufficient data'
expectedBehavior: scoreAge: ageSec < 30 → full 15 pts + 'insufficient data' reason
failureMode: Token 29 seconds old gets 15 pts; token 31 seconds old gets 12 pts — abrupt cliff at 30s boundary
prerequisites: Token aged exactly 30 seconds

description: Sniper frenzy detection: >30 swaps/min on token <1h old gets +5
expectedBehavior: scoreAge: swapsPerMin > 30 → +5 'sniper frenzy'; >15 → +3 'elevated velocity'
failureMode: Token with organic bot trading (arbitrageurs) may show >30 swaps/min — false positive 'sniper frenzy'
prerequisites: Token under 1 hour old with high swap velocity

description: 5m divergence pattern: 5m↑ + 1h↓ = exit liquidity trap
expectedBehavior: scorePriceAction: p5m > 100 && p1h < -30 → +8 pts 'exit liquidity trap'
failureMode: Token recovering from a dip (5m green, 1h still red) incorrectly flagged as exit liquidity trap
prerequisites: Token with >100% 5m pump but -30%+ 1h drop

description: Name hygiene: unicode spam symbol hard-scored at 10 pts + block
expectedBehavior: scoreNameHygiene: isUnicodeSpam(true) → return {score:10, block:true}
failureMode: Token with legitimate accented character (e.g., 'Cafecito Token') may trigger >30% non-ASCII threshold
prerequisites: Token symbol with >30% non-ASCII characters

description: All-caps spam detection for tokens with 20+ char all-caps symbols
expectedBehavior: scoreNameHygiene: isAllCapsSpam → symbol === symbol.toUpperCase() && /^[A-Z0-9_]+$/ && length >= 20 → 10 pts + block
failureMode: Blocked only if length >= 20; all-caps symbol with length 19 passes through — arbitrary boundary
prerequisites: Token with 19-char all-caps symbol

description: Fee integrity: avg trade fee < $0.001 flagged as impossible-to-be-organic dust
expectedBehavior: scoreVolume: expectedFee < 0.001 → +12 pts 'dust, impossible to be organic'
failureMode: Token with extremely low price but legitimate volume (e.g., 0.0000001 SOL/token) — every trade is small absolute value
prerequisites: Token with many small-value trades

description: Swap storm detection: swap/vol ratio > 0.1 = wash trading
expectedBehavior: scoreVolume: swapVolRatio > 0.1 → +10 pts 'swap storm, wash'; > 0.05 → +6 'suspicious'; > 0.02 → +2 'elevated'
failureMode: Legitimate memecoin with many small retail trades could have high swap/vol ratio — false wash positive
prerequisites: Token with many small trades relative to total volume

description: Bot pump signature: very few swaps for very high volume
expectedBehavior: scoreVolume: swapVolRatio < 0.0005 && swaps < 10 && vol > $50k → +10 'bot pump signature'
failureMode: Legitimate whale making few large trades arrives at token — triggers bot pump detection
prerequisites: Token with 2 swaps totaling $100k volume

description: Distribution scoring: pump > 300% 1h then dump > 20% 5m = distribution trap
expectedBehavior: scoreDistribution: p1h > 300 && p5m < -20 → +12 pts 'pump & dump distribution'
failureMode: Token pumping 300% then correcting 20% is natural price discovery in volatile memecoins — not necessarily distribution
prerequisites: Token with classic pump-and-dump pattern

description: Boost/Ads AFTER pump (>100%) = distribution signal
expectedBehavior: scoreDistribution: token.boosts > 0 && priceChange1h > 100 → +10 pts Boost distribution signal
failureMode: Boost before pump gets negative score (reward), boost after pump gets +10 — timing is everything but hard to verify
prerequisites: Token with boost count > 0 and >100% 1h pump

description: Many buyers + falling price = whales distributing into buy pressure
expectedBehavior: scoreDistribution: h1Buys > 50 && p1h < -30 → +10 pts 'whales distributing into buyers'
failureMode: Token with strong sell pressure that also has many buyers (natural market) flagged as distribution
prerequisites: Token with >50 buys/hour and >30% price drop

description: Volume 10x MCAP detection for manufactured volume
expectedBehavior: scoreVolume: vol/mcap > 10 → +8 'manufactured'; >5 → +5 'suspicious'; >2 → +2 'elevated'
failureMode: Token with small MCAP but genuine viral volume (e.g., MCAP $5k, vol $100k) flagged as manufactured
prerequisites: Token with volume/MCAP ratio > 10

description: outerShieldScreen flow: RugCheck summary batch -> hard block -> extension check -> trash scoring
expectedBehavior: Step 1: rugCheckBatchScreen; Step 2: hard-block critical/scores >= 60; Step 3: token-2022 extension check; Step 4: scoreTrash + rugcheck dimension
failureMode: RugCheck API down: all 4 steps skip, tokens pass through with only trash scoring — no outer shield
prerequisites: Tokens being screened with RugCheck API available

description: Token-2022 extension check: freeze authority = instant block
expectedBehavior: checkTokenExtensions: rugReport.freeze_authority true → block=true, reason mentions freeze
failureMode: RugCheck report format changes — freeze_authority field renamed, check misses it
prerequisites: Token-2022 token with freeze authority enabled

description: Token-2022 permanent delegate detection blocks token confiscation risk
expectedBehavior: checkTokenExtensions: risk.name includes 'permanent_delegate' → block=true, Indonesian warning
failureMode: Risk description in Indonesian: user-facing messages may confuse English-speaking operators
prerequisites: Token-2022 with permanent delegate

description: Token-2022 non-transferable check blocks soulbound tokens
expectedBehavior: checkTokenExtensions: risk includes 'non_transferable' or 'soulbound' → block=true
failureMode: Non-transferable tokens are legitimate for certain use cases (identity, governance) but Ponyou cannot sell them — correct to block
prerequisites: Non-transferable token-2022

description: Helius rate limiter prevents API abuse with 2 concurrent slots, 1.5s interval
expectedBehavior: heliusAcquire: waits for inflight slot; calculates next available timeslot; sleeps if needed
failureMode: Helius free tier burst capacity exceeded: sequential fetches spaced 1.5s apart, max 2 concurrent
prerequisites: Multiple concurrent callers requesting Helius data

description: Helius circuit breaker opens after 3 consecutive 429s for 5 minutes
expectedBehavior: helius429Hit increments streak; at threshold 3, sets CB open for 5 min; heliusAcquire throws immediately
failureMode: Circuit stays open for full 5 min even after Helius recovers — must wait cooldown or manual reset
prerequisites: 3 consecutive Helius 429 responses

description: Helius success resets 429 streak and closes circuit
expectedBehavior: heliusSuccess: sets _helius429Streak=0; if circuit was open, closes it and logs
failureMode: Circuit closed after single success even if underlying rate issue persists — may oscillate open/close
prerequisites: Circuit open due to 429s, then a success response arrives

description: Shyft fallback used when Helius circuit is open
expectedBehavior: gatherRugSignals: if heliusCircuitOpen and SHYFT_API_KEY configured, call getFreshFundedCountShyft
failureMode: Shyft API may have different data quality; fallback marked as 'helius_circuit_open:shyft_fallback_used' in reason
prerequisites: Helius circuit open, Shyft key configured

description: DexScreener-only mode skips all Helius/Shyft wallet analysis
expectedBehavior: SCREENING_MODE === 'dexscreener' → skip fresh holders, sybil, bundle checks; _data_quality='dexscreener'
failureMode: This mode disables all on-chain behavioral signals; only DexScreener LP lock + wash trade remain
prerequisites: SCREENING_MODE env var set to 'dexscreener'

description: Fresh funded holder detection with 24-hour window from launch
expectedBehavior: getFreshFundedCount: checks if earliest SOL funding of each top 8 holder is within launchTs +/- maxAgeHours
failureMode: Helius txns fetch may miss early transactions (rate limited) — fresh holder count could be under-reported
prerequisites: Token with holder owners array and launch timestamp

description: Sybil cluster detection: top holders funded by same wallet = cluster signal
expectedBehavior: getSameFunderCluster: for top 10 holders, find earliest SOL funder; cluster count = max holders sharing funder
failureMode: Legitimate CEX withdrawal: multiple holders funded from same CEX hot wallet appear as sybil cluster
prerequisites: Token with holders and Helius API available

description: Bundle buyer detection: % of supply bought in first 60s of pool creation
expectedBehavior: getBundleBuyersPct: fetch SWAP txns within launchTs + 60s window; count distinct receivers as bundle heuristic
failureMode: Window too narrow: professional sniper bots may buy within seconds; 60s captures most but could miss fast snipes
prerequisites: Token mint and pool creation timestamp

description: Bundle heuristic: >1 distinct receiver in one tx = bundle buy activity
expectedBehavior: getBundleBuyersPct: distinctReceivers.size > 1 means bundle tx; all associated buys counted as bundle
failureMode: Airdrop distribution: contract distributing to multiple wallets in one tx is also >1 receiver — false bundle positive
prerequisites: Token with early distribution transaction

description: Wash trade scoring: extreme buy/sell imbalance with low unique traders
expectedBehavior: getWashTradeScore: buys/sells ratio > 5 or < 0.2 → +30; >3 or < 0.33 → +15; micro-trades add +10
failureMode: Total < 20 transactions returns wash_score=0 immediately — tokens with 19 txns get a pass on wash analysis
prerequisites: Token with >20 h1 transactions

description: extractFeatureVector produces 17 boolean features from rug signals
expectedBehavior: Features: high_top10, fresh_holders, dust_holders, has_freeze, has_mint, creator_heavy, bundle_buy, bundled_launch, top20_concentrated, same_funder, transfer_fee_high, transfer_hook, permanent_delegate, non_transferable, default_frozen, lp_unlocked, wash_trade
failureMode: Adding new feature requires updating both extractFeatureVector AND toNumericVector in rug-anomaly.js
prerequisites: Rug signals object with any fields

description: learnPatterns requires minimum 3 rugs before pattern learning activates
expectedBehavior: MIN_OCCURRENCES_TO_LEARN = 3; rugs.length < 3 → return {learned:0, note:'not enough history'}
failureMode: New bot: must accumulate 3 rug entries before pattern learning starts — cold start period with no learned protection
prerequisites: rug-memory.json with 0-2 entries

description: Confidence scoring formula balances support, breadth, and count
expectedBehavior: computeConfidence: 22% base + (support * 0.38) + (breadth * 0.18) + (countScore * 0.22); clamped 0.15-0.95
failureMode: Pattern with count=3 and support=100% gets high confidence even if it's a coincidence
prerequisites: Multiple rug entries with overlapping feature vectors

description: Auto-approval: confidence >= 0.8 AND count >= 5 promotes pattern automatically
expectedBehavior: learnPatterns: reviewed = confidence >= 0.8 && count >= 5 → weight up to 35, review_status='approved'
failureMode: Auto-approval bypasses human review for patterns that may be coincidental (5 rugs sharing 1 common feature)
prerequisites: 5+ rug entries with high-confidence feature overlap

description: Unreviewed patterns capped at 18 weight vs approved 35 weight
expectedBehavior: UNREVIEWED_WEIGHT_CAP=18, LEARNED_WEIGHT_CAP=35; pending patterns have lower max scoring impact
failureMode: Soft patterns still contribute up to 18 score points — enough to push a token from WARN to BLOCK
prerequisites: Token matching only unreviewed learned patterns

description: matchPatterns combines seed + learned patterns, matching all features with AND logic
expectedBehavior: All required features must match (every): if pattern has features [A,B], token must have both A and B true
failureMode: AND logic is strict: pattern with 3+ features requires all 3 to match — a rug with 2/3 features is missed
prerequisites: Token matching some but not all features of a known pattern

description: RugCheck report request with 2 retries and exponential backoff
expectedBehavior: fetchRugCheck: retries up to 2 times with 1.2s * i delay; 429 triggers 4s * i extended delay
failureMode: RugCheck free API rate limit: at scale (100+ tokens), sequential fetches with delays may hold up pipeline
prerequisites: RugCheck endpoint available

description: 404 token (not indexed) returns gracefully, not an error
expectedBehavior: fetchRugCheck: 404 → return { not_found: true }; getRugCheckReport returns { indexed: false }
failureMode: Very new tokens not indexed by RugCheck pass through without any RugCheck verification
prerequisites: Token not yet indexed by RugCheck.xyz

description: RugCheck report maps risk levels to score_impact: critical=30, danger=15, warn=5
expectedBehavior: getRugCheckReport: each risk mapped with score_impact based on level; total_risk_score accumulated
failureMode: New risk level not in {critical, danger, warn} falls through → score_impact undefined; not catastrophic since used only for total
prerequisites: RugCheck report with risks array

description: Batch screen processes tokens in chunks of 8 to avoid rate limits
expectedBehavior: rugCheckBatchScreen: tokens split into chunks of 8; each chunk processed via Promise.all for parallelism
failureMode: Chunks processed sequentially: chunk 1 (8 tokens) -> wait all -> chunk 2. Total time: (n/8) * max_per_token_latency
prerequisites: 10+ tokens being batch-screened

description: RugCheck cache capped at 500 entries with LRU eviction
expectedBehavior: putCache: after .set(), if size > 500, find oldest entry (sorted by ts) and delete it
failureMode: LRU eviction sorts full cache entries each time — O(500 log 500) sort per eviction, may slow down at scale
prerequisites: Cache filled with 500+ entries

description: Anomaly detection requires 10+ rug corpus to produce scores
expectedBehavior: detectAnomaly: corpus.length < 10 → return {anomaly_score:0, anomaly_detected:false}
failureMode: First 9 rugs: anomaly detection is silent; no protection against novel rug patterns until corpus grows
prerequisites: rug-memory.json with <10 entries

description: Cosine similarity sigmoid mapping: 0.5 sim -> 25 score, 0.7 -> 60, 0.85 -> 85
expectedBehavior: anomalyScore = min(100, maxSim * 100 * (maxSim > 0.5 ? 1.2 : 0.8)) — score jumps significantly above 0.5 threshold
failureMode: Token with 0.49 similarity to closest rug gets 39 score; token with 0.51 gets 61 — massive difference at 0.5 boundary
prerequisites: Rug corpus with 10+ entries, token signals available

description: hasAnyActiveFlag shortcuts anomaly check for zero-flag tokens
expectedBehavior: toNumericVector(signals).some(v > 0) — if all 17 dimensions are 0, skip full similarity computation
failureMode: Token with no active flags is clearly not anomalous, but misses similarity to rugs that also had zero flags
prerequisites: Token signals with all 17 features false/0

description: Anomaly score threshold 50+ triggers anomaly_detected=true, triggering downstream LLM analysis
expectedBehavior: detectAnomaly returns anomaly_detected=true when anomalyScore >= 50
failureMode: Score 49.5 rounds to 50 (due to Math.round) — correct; score 49 rounds to 49 — anomaly not detected
prerequisites: Token signals producing anomaly score near 50

description: LLM analysis only fires when rug corpus has 25+ entries
expectedBehavior: MIN_RUG_CORPUS = 25; rugCorpusSize < MIN_RUG_CORPUS → skipped with 'insufficient_rug_corpus' reason
failureMode: Bot with 24 rugs: LLM analysis skipped, ambiguous tokens (score 25-55) not evaluated by LLM
prerequisites: rug-memory.json with <25 entries

description: LLM analysis times out at 8 seconds to avoid blocking screening cycle
expectedBehavior: AbortController with 8000ms timeout; on timeout, catch returns {verdict:'error', adjustment:0, skipped:true}
failureMode: LLM provider slow (15s response) — timeout fires, analysis skipped, token passes with no LLM adjustment
prerequisites: LLM client configured and available

description: LLM responses parsed: 'RUG'=+20, 'SUSPICIOUS'=+8, 'SAFE'=-5 adjustment
expectedBehavior: parseRugVerdict: RUG adj+20, SUSPICIOUS adj+8, SAFE adj-5, unknown adj=0
failureMode: LLM returns 'NOT RUG' — parseRugVerdict checks for 'RUG' but excludes 'NOT RUG' and 'ANTI-RUG' via guard
prerequisites: LLM returns classification string

description: HOT market: wider stops (-22% SL, -30% CL), larger probe (0.20), higher sweep (55%)
expectedBehavior: adjustByMarket(HOT): probeSizeFraction=0.20, hotBoost=0.10, stopLoss=-22%, cutLoss=-30%, sweep=55%
failureMode: HOT market wide stops: in volatile hot market, -22% stoploss may be too wide for frequent false signals
prerequisites: marketCondition='HOT'

description: COLD market: tighter stops (-10% SL, -16% CL), smaller probe (0.15), lower sweep (25%)
expectedBehavior: adjustByMarket(COLD): probeSizeFraction=0.15, coldPenalty=0.20, stopLoss=-10%, cutLoss=-16%, sweep=25%
failureMode: COLD market tight stops: natural memecoin volatility may trigger -10% SL frequently, causing many premature exits
prerequisites: marketCondition='COLD'

description: DEAD market: zero sizing, -3% hard stop, no trailing
expectedBehavior: adjustByMarket(DEAD): probeSizeFraction=0, minFraction=0, stopLoss=-3%, cutLoss=-5%, trailingTrigger=0, sweep=0
failureMode: In DEAD market, virtually no trading allowed; -3% stoploss is extremely tight
prerequisites: marketCondition='DEAD'

description: Strategy stoploss overrides market-adjusted defaults
expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: if strategyParams.stoploss is finite and between -0.01 and -0.50, convert to % and use; hardCutLoss = stoploss * 1.6
failureMode: strategyParams.stoploss = -0.60 (below -0.50): not applied, market default used — strategy intent overridden
prerequisites: Active strategy with stoploss parameter

description: Strategy trailing stop enabled: positive_offset and positive_distance override defaults
expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: strategyParams.trailing_stop.enabled=true → trigger=offset*100, drop=distance*100
failureMode: Decimal-to-percent conversion: offset=0.05 → trigger=5% (correct); offset=5 (already pct) → trigger=500% (broken)
prerequisites: Strategy with trailing_stop config

description: High conviction (>=70) and confidence (>=45) boosts probe size by +0.05
expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: convictionScore>=70 && confidenceScore>=45 → probeSizeFraction += 0.05, clamped 0.1-0.6
failureMode: Probe size boost could push allocation above intended risk budget for the position
prerequisites: conviction object with score>=70 and confidence>=45

description: Rug score >= hardBlockRugScore (30) sets flagTolerance=0, zero flags allowed
expectedBehavior: rugScore >= 30 → entry.flagTolerance=0; rugScore >= 20 → flagTolerance=0 and probe clamped to 0.25
failureMode: flagTolerance=0 means any downstream flag blocks entry; rugScore exactly 20 uses threshold at line 142-144
prerequisites: Token with rug score between 20-30

description: 2+ flags force flagTolerance=0 and cap probe size at 0.25
expectedBehavior: flagCount >= 2 → entry.flagTolerance=0, probeSizeFraction = min(probeSizeFraction, 0.25)
failureMode: Flag count includes trash flags from trash-layer; a token with 2 minor flags gets aggressive penalty
prerequisites: Token with 2+ trash flags

description: evaluateExitPolicy: hardCutLoss triggers at or below configured percentage
expectedBehavior: evaluateExitPolicy: pnl <= policy.exit.hardCutLossPct → hardCutLoss=true with reason string
failureMode: Exact boundary: pnl exactly -22% when CL=-22% triggers (<=). Tiny floating point: -21.9999% vs -22% could differ
prerequisites: Position P&L at cut loss threshold

description: Trailing stop activates when peak >= trigger and PNL drop exceeds configured distance
expectedBehavior: evaluateExitPolicy: trailingDropPct > 0 && peak >= trailingTriggerPct && pnl <= (peak - trailingDropPct)
failureMode: Trailing drop in 'absolute' mode: peak=15%, drop=5%, trigger=5% → triggered when pnl <= 10% (correct for trailing from peak)
prerequisites: Position in profit with trailing stop enabled

description: Profit sweep eligible when PNL >= profitSweepPct
expectedBehavior: evaluateExitPolicy: profitSweepPct > 0 && pnl >= profitSweepPct → profitSweepEligible=true
failureMode: Sweep at exactly threshold: pnl=35% when sweep=35% → eligible (>=). Partial TP logic uses this flag
prerequisites: Position P&L above profit sweep threshold

description: Session drawdown > -15% trips kill switch automatically
expectedBehavior: reportBalance: ((usd - baseline) / baseline) * 100 <= -15 → trip() with reason='drawdown'
failureMode: Transient RPC failure returning usd=0: guard `usd <= 0` at line 116 prevents false trip from 0 reading
prerequisites: Session baseline set, balance drops >15%

description: 3 consecutive swap failures trip the kill switch
expectedBehavior: recordSwapOutcome: !success → _consecutiveErrors++ → if >= 3 → trip('consecutive_errors')
failureMode: Network blips causing 3 sequential swap failures trip the kill switch unnecessarily
prerequisites: 3 consecutive failed swap attempts

description: Successful swap resets consecutive error counter
expectedBehavior: recordSwapOutcome: success=true → _consecutiveErrors = 0; state persisted
failureMode: One success between failures correctly resets counter; requires 3 consecutive failures from that point
prerequisites: Some failed swaps recorded, then a success

description: Kill switch survives restart via flag file on disk
expectedBehavior: trip() writes kill-switch.flag JSON; isKilled() reads it; restart sees flag and stays killed
failureMode: Flag file in git-managed directory could be cleaned during deploy; state restored via _restoreState from state file
prerequisites: Kill switch tripped, then process restarts

description: reportBalance guards against usd=0 (RPC failure) with early return
expectedBehavior: Line 116: !Number.isFinite(usd) || usd <= 0 || _sessionStartUsd == null → return false (no trip)
failureMode: If RPC consistently returns 0, kill switch never trips but bot keeps losing money trading with 0 balance reading
prerequisites: RPC returning 0 for wallet balance

description: Session baseline can be set once; second call with same value is idempotent
expectedBehavior: setSessionBaseline: if !Number.isFinite(usd) || usd <= 0, return without setting
failureMode: Baseline set very low (e.g., $1) means drawdown calculation is based on tiny reference — trip may never trigger
prerequisites: Initialization call to setSessionBaseline

description: Flag file unreadable returns generic kill state (fail-safe)
expectedBehavior: readKillState: catch block returns { reason: 'unknown', detail: 'flag file unreadable' } — still considered killed
failureMode: Corrupted flag file prevents resume even after manual recovery; must delete flag file manually
prerequisites: Flag file exists but is corrupted

description: reset() clears flag file, state file, and in-memory counters
expectedBehavior: Deletes both FLAG_FILE and STATE_FILE; resets _consecutiveErrors=0, _sessionStartUsd=null
failureMode: File deletion fails silently (permissions) — flag persists but log says reset complete
prerequisites: Killed bot with flag and state files present

description: 3 rug events in 30-minute window trips circuit breaker for 4 hours
expectedBehavior: createRugCircuitBreaker: maxEvents=3, windowMs=30min, lockDurationMs=4h; events array tracked; at 3rd event, locked until now+4h
failureMode: Consecutive exits from same token counted as multiple events — a single catastrophic rug may trip breaker
prerequisites: 3 rug exits within 30 minutes

description: Events older than window are pruned automatically
expectedBehavior: _prune: remove events with ts < (now - windowMs); array stays lean
failureMode: Window sliding: if events at t=0, t=10min, t=25min, t=40min — at t=40min, t=0 event pruned, only 2 events remain (within 30min)
prerequisites: Rug events spread longer than the window

description: Circuit breaker lock prevents new entries but does NOT stop active position monitoring
expectedBehavior: isLocked() returns true; used by index.js checkAllGates to skip new entries. Rug-monitor still runs
failureMode: 4-hour lock is long; if market recovers quickly, bot misses opportunities for 4 hours
prerequisites: Circuit breaker tripped

description: getStatus returns lock state, remaining minutes, and lock reason
expectedBehavior: getStatus: { locked, lockedUntil, resumeInMin, lockReason, recentCount, maxEvents, windowMs }
failureMode: resumeInMin computed as Math.ceil((lockedUntil - now) / 60000) — at 3.5 minutes remaining, reports 4 minutes (ceil)
prerequisites: Breaker in locked state

description: reset() clears events, lock state, and reason completely
expectedBehavior: reset: events.length=0, lockedUntil=0, lockReason=null — circuit fully open
failureMode: Manual reset after fixing root cause allows immediate trading; must be called explicitly
prerequisites: Tripped breaker

description: recordExit with mint and reason tracks which token triggered the exit
expectedBehavior: recordExit(mint, reason): pushes {mint, reason, ts} to events array
failureMode: Duplicate mints counted as separate events if they exit multiple times (e.g., partial close then full close)
prerequisites: Position exited (rug detected)

description: detectDevSell: deployer dev balance drop exceeding thresholds raises severity
expectedBehavior: detectDevSell: deltaPct <= thresholds.high → HIGH, <= thresholds.medium → MEDIUM, <= thresholds.low → LOW
failureMode: Dev selling naturally to raise funds looks identical to rug pull to this detector — false positives
prerequisites: Deployer token balance tracked at entry

description: detectLpMovement: deployer removing liquidity triggers HIGH severity
expectedBehavior: detectLpMovement: removeLiquidityBy === deployerWallet → SEVERITY.HIGH
failureMode: Legitimate LP management by deployer (rebalancing) also triggers HIGH severity — immediate false alarm
prerequisites: Deployer wallet known, LP address tracked

description: detectAuthorityChange: new mint_authority detected after entry = HIGH severity
expectedBehavior: detectAuthorityChange: atEntry mint_authority null, current set → HIGH (unless transferred to burn)
failureMode: Token revoking mint authority (set to null): not detected as severity (reverse direction not a risk)
prerequisites: Token authorities snapshot at entry

description: detectHolderDump: cumulative holder sell-off within 5-minute window triggers severity
expectedBehavior: detectHolderDump: cumulative tokens sold / snapshotTotal * 100; deltaPct <= thresholds → severity
failureMode: Holder dump detection depends on top-holder snapshot at entry — if snapshot is stale, may miss or misreport
prerequisites: Top-holder snapshot taken at position entry

description: attachPosition subscribes to Geyser stream for real-time monitoring
expectedBehavior: attachPosition: if geyserStream.subscribe exists, subscribe to deployer_token_account, lp_address, and mint
failureMode: Geyser stream disconnection: subscriptions silently drop, polling continues but real-time alerts lost
prerequisites: Geyser stream configured and connected

description: Polling interval defaults to 30 seconds for active position checks
expectedBehavior: pollingMs = (config.pollingIntervalSec || 30) * 1000; _schedulePolling uses setTimeout for loop
failureMode: 30-second poll interval: deployer could drain 90% of LP within 30 seconds before poll detects it
prerequisites: Position attached to monitor

description: detachPosition cleans up polling and Geyser subscriptions
expectedBehavior: detachPosition: clears polling timeout, unsubscribes all Geyser subs, marks state.shutdown=true, deletes from Map
failureMode: If geyserStream is null or unsubscribe throws, catch block in for loop continues — individual sub may leak
prerequisites: Position monitored and then closed

description: Max wins (default 3) or max losses (default 3) per day triggers pending_decision state
expectedBehavior: recordDailyTradeOutcome: wins >= maxWinsPerDay OR losses >= maxLossesPerDay → status='pending_decision'
failureMode: Win/loss counts from both thresholds can trigger simultaneously — only the threshold that hits first matters
prerequisites: Win or loss count reaches configured daily limit

description: Midnight reset: state.date field changes, state resets to defaults
expectedBehavior: loadState: if parsed.date !== dateKey(nowMs) → return defaultState(nowMs) — fresh state per day
failureMode: Timezone issues: dateKey uses toISOString().slice(0,10) which is UTC. If operator is in -5, day resets at 7PM local, not midnight
prerequisites: Guard configured and active, crossing UTC midnight

description: decideDailyTradeGuard('continue') acknowledges threshold and continues trading
expectedBehavior: decideDailyTradeGuard: action='continue' → ack threshold key in acknowledgedThresholds, status='continued', pendingDecision cleared
failureMode: Continue decision does NOT reset counters; it only acknowledges — trade could hit another loss and need another continue
prerequisites: Guard in pending_decision state

description: decideDailyTradeGuard('stop') stops trading for the day
expectedBehavior: decideDailyTradeGuard: action='stop' → status='stopped', pendingDecision cleared
failureMode: 'stop' sets status='stopped' but does NOT reset state; isDailyTradeGuardEntryBlocked returns blocked until midnight reset
prerequisites: Guard in pending_decision state

description: isDailyTradeGuardEntryBlocked returns blocked with reason when status is pending_decision or stopped
expectedBehavior: isDailyTradeGuardEntryBlocked: enabled && blocked → return block=true, reason includes count/limit
failureMode: When not enabled, returns {blocked:false} immediately — guard disabled means no protection
prerequisites: Guard in pending_decision or stopped state

description: Events log capped at 100 entries to prevent unbounded growth
expectedBehavior: recordDailyTradeOutcome: after push, if events.length > 100, events = events.slice(-100)
failureMode: High-frequency trading could hit 100 events quickly, losing early-day history
prerequisites: 100+ trade outcomes recorded in single day

description: Guard counts only enabled trades; disabled guard returns triggered=false always
expectedBehavior: recordDailyTradeOutcome: !cfg.enabled → return {..., triggered: false} immediately without updating state
failureMode: Win/loss tracking is skipped when disabled — cannot retroactively enable to see today's trade history
prerequisites: Daily trade guard disabled in config

description: isPartialTPLanded prevents duplicate TP execution for same position+attempt
expectedBehavior: isPartialTPLanded: check state[`${positionKey}::${attempt}`]?.landed; returns true if already submitted
failureMode: If state file is deleted between mark and check, TP could execute twice (race condition risk)
prerequisites: Partial TP previously marked as landed

description: markPartialTPLanded uses file lock for atomicity
expectedBehavior: markPartialTPLanded: withFileLock -> load -> set key -> save -> release
failureMode: File lock mechanism: if path doesn't exist or lock acquisition fails, operation may fail silently
prerequisites: Partial TP to be marked landed

description: clearPartialTPGuard removes all records for a position after full close
expectedBehavior: clearPartialTPGuard: iterate all keys, delete those starting with `${positionKey}::`
failureMode: Position key with special regex characters (dots, parens) could cause issues if key parsing changes; simple string startsWith is safe
prerequisites: Position with multiple partial TP records, now fully closed

description: prunePartialTPGuard removes entries older than 7 days
expectedBehavior: prunePartialTPGuard: maxAgeDays=7; entries with ts < cutoff (7 days ago) are deleted
failureMode: If entry has no ts field (older format), val.ts is undefined -> undefined < cutoff is false -> never pruned
prerequisites: Entries older than 7 days in guard state

description: NORMAL market: probeSizeFraction=0.05, confidence floors=25/40/50 for shadow/probe/active
expectedBehavior: DEFAULT_POLICY: shadowConfidenceFloor=25, probeConfidenceFloor=40, activeConfidenceFloor=50, probeSizeFraction=0.05
failureMode: These are reasonable defaults but could be too aggressive for small accounts
prerequisites: Default risk policy construction

description: trailing_stop.enabled=false explicitly disables trailing stop
expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: strategyParams.trailing_stop.enabled=false → trailingTriggerPct=0, trailingDropPct=0
failureMode: Strategy setting 'enabled': false vs 'enabled': 'false' — false !== 'false' for the === comparison
prerequisites: Strategy with trailing_stop explicitly disabled

description: COLD market clamps stoploss to max -10% even if strategy wants wider
expectedBehavior: adjustByMarket(COLD) sets SL=-10%; then buildRiskPolicy line 167: Math.max(hardStopLossPct, -10) — strategy SL of -15% becomes -10%
failureMode: COLD market forces -10% max stoploss regardless of strategy intent — strategy may expect wider loss tolerance
prerequisites: COLD market with strategy requesting wider stoploss

description: COLD market clamps take profit to max 130%
expectedBehavior: buildRiskPolicy: condition==='COLD' && immediateTakeProfitPct is finite → takeProfitPct = min(takeProfitPct, 130)
failureMode: Strategy with 200% TP in COLD market gets clamped to 130% — position may close earlier than strategy expects
prerequisites: COLD market with strategy TP > 130%
